content: {"save": ["In the Workshop, starting on the Notice Board tile at (2,7) leaves the body permanently stuck; no movement, walk helper, KeyE, or waiting frees it, so crafting is impossible from that state."], "persona": ["If the body becomes immobile on a special tile (e.g., Notice Board), treat it as a soft-lock: stop retrying movement/interaction and report the stuck state rather than burning many tasks on it.", "When a delegated crafting goal requires reaching a workbench, first verify the body can move off its starting tile before attempting navigation."]}
